texts.li: {A_nameDef} sat down and stood straight back up again. The bench was sticky.
{A_nameDef} picked a hair out of {A_possessive} food and stopped eating.
{A_nameDef} stepped in something on the floor and decided not to look at what.
{A_nameDef} wiped {A_possessive} hands on {A_possessive} shirt, and they came away dirtier.
The floor was gritty under {A_nameDef}'s boots, and the corners were worse.
"When was this place last swept?" {A_nameDef} asked the room at large.
[child] {A_nameDef} drew a face in the dust on the table.
[summer|hot] Flies circled the grime in the corner while {A_nameDef} tried to work.
{A_nameDef} worked indoors in a coat, breath showing in the air.
{A_nameDef} kept stopping to blow on {A_possessive} fingers. The room never warmed up.
Blanket round the shoulders, {A_nameDef} kept working.
{A_nameDef} stamped {A_possessive} feet under the table to keep them from going numb.
[winter] Frost had crept up the inside of the wall by {A_nameDef}'s bench.
[night] {A_nameDef} couldn't get warm in there and went to bed early just to be under a blanket.
[child] {A_nameDef} wore two hats indoors and still complained about the cold.
{A_nameDef} sat as close to the fire as {A_pronoun} could get and still felt the draft on {A_possessive} back.
The water in {A_nameDef}'s cup was cold enough to hurt {A_possessive} teeth.
{A_nameDef} propped the door open, but the room was still like an oven.
Sweat ran into {A_nameDef}'s eyes while {A_pronoun} worked.
{A_nameDef} fanned {A_possessive} face with whatever was to hand. The air didn't move.
A whole jug of water, and {A_nameDef} was thirsty again within the hour.
The air in the room was thick and still, and {A_nameDef} kept stepping outside for a breath.
{A_nameDef}'s shirt stuck to {A_possessive} back the whole afternoon.
[night] {A_nameDef} lay on top of the blankets in the heat, waiting for the night to cool down.
{A_nameDef}'s bed is more {THING} than bed these days.
There was a half-chewed bone under {A_nameDef}'s bed this morning, and it wasn't {A_nameDef}'s.
{A_nameDef} had to shove a warm, heavy animal off the bed before {A_pronoun} could lie down.
{A_nameDef}'s blanket smells of {THING} now, and so does the pillow.
Muddy prints all over {A_nameDef}'s pillow, and the animal asleep at the foot of the bed looking innocent.
[child] {A_nameDef} let the animal sleep on the bed again, and got told off for it.
The hammering on the new {THING} went on next to {A_nameDef}'s room from dawn to dusk.
{A_nameDef} found grit and shavings in {A_possessive} bed from the work on the {THING}.
{A_nameDef} tripped over a pile of materials left for the {THING} right outside {A_possessive} door.
"How much longer?" {A_nameDef} asked about the {THING}, and got a shrug.
{A_nameDef} couldn't get any peace in {A_possessive} room for the banging next door.
[morning] The builders started on the {THING} at first light, right by where {A_nameDef} sleeps.
Broom in hand, {A_nameDef} chased a wild {THING} out of the room.
A wild {THING} had been at the food, and {A_nameDef} found the droppings to prove it.
The scratching behind {A_nameDef}'s wall was a wild {THING}, and it had built a nest.
{A_nameDef} jumped when a wild {THING} shot out from under the table.
[night] {A_nameDef} lay listening to a wild {THING} rustling about in the dark.
[child] {A_nameDef} tried to keep the wild {THING} as a pet and was told no.
{A_nameDef} set a trap for the wild {THING} and caught nothing but {A_possessive} own thumb.
The bread was nibbled through, and {A_nameDef} knew which wild {THING} to blame.
Dirt in the blanket again. The bare earth floor in {A_nameDef}'s room gets into everything.
{A_nameDef} swept the earth floor of {A_possessive} room, which only moved the dirt around.
{A_nameDef}'s boots left a trail of dust from {A_possessive} room to the table.
A beetle in {A_nameDef}'s bed, come up through the earth floor.
[rain] Water seeped up through the earth floor in {A_nameDef}'s room and turned it to mud.
[winter] The bare earth floor in {A_nameDef}'s room was cold as stone through {A_possessive} socks.
{A_nameDef} dropped a button on the earth floor of {A_possessive} room and never found it again.
